raw_sections.summary:
SUMMARY
Senior Java Backend Engineer with 10+ years of experience in building scalable microservices, REST APIs, and cloud-native solutions. Skilled in Core Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, Kafka and OCI/AWS, with a proven record of improving system performance, modernizing legacy modules, and resolving 120+ high-priority issues. Recognized for delivering reliable enterprise solutions and mentoring teams under Agile practices.
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE	
Seasonal Intern — Cerner Healthcare Solutions, Jan 2014 – Jun 2014 | Orders
Contributed to Non-Medication Duplicate Alert project (C++, SVN), fixing bugs and supporting global healthcare applications.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE SKILLS
Senior Member Technical Staff — Oracle Corporation, Bengaluru
Jan 2023 – Present | Fusion MW Suite - HCM
Delivered 20+ backend enhancements across Core HR, Absence, and Performance, improving reliability and cutting response times by ~20%.
Designed and deployed 15+ REST APIs for Payroll, Leave, and Employee workflows, streamlining integrations and reducing resolution time.
Implemented Payroll–Leave integration, enabling real- time sync and reducing payroll corrections by ~25%.
Enhanced Performance & Goal Management APIs, improving manager visibility and review turnaround.
Aug 2020 – Dec 2023 | Oracle ADF – Sustaining Engineering
Resolved 120+ defects, including 80+ Dev Priority-1 escalations, across ADF Faces, JBO, Accessibility, and OAG components, ensuring stability for enterprise customers.
Delivered complex fixes for cross-environment issues, latent defects, and escalated cases, significantly improving product reliability.
Developed expertise in Accessibility (VPAT compliance) and internationalization (i18n/l10n), independently driving compliance-critical resolutions.
Enhanced performance and scalability by analyzing and resolving memory, CPU, and responsiveness- related issues, reducing downtime and improving end- user experience.
Core Java, SQL, Data Structures and Algorithms, Design Patterns, System Design.
Spring Framework, Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA, Spring REST, REST APIs, Microservices, API Gateway, Apache Kafka, Swagger/Open API.
AWS, Oracle Cloud (OCI), Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, GitHub, CI/CD, Performance Tuning.
Oracle, MySQL, Tomcat, WebLogic.
JUnit, Mockito, SonarQube, Splunk, ELK, Grafana OAuth2, JWT, Spring Security, Postman
Agile (Scrum/Kanban), IntelliJ, Eclipse, Maven, Git, JIRA, Stakeholder Management, Mentoring.

Associate Senior Software Engineer — Cerner Healthcare Solutions, Bengaluru, Bengaluru

Migrated 7 legacy modules to Spring Boot microservices, cutting API response times and improving scalability.
Designed and integrated 20+ physician order actions (Void, Cancel, Renew, etc.), streamlining clinical workflows.
Delivered production-ready code with 95%+ unit test coverage, ensuring stable and high-quality releases.
Mentored junior engineers on REST API design and microservices practices, boosting team efficiency and code quality.
Software Engineer — Cerner Healthcare Solutions, Bengaluru
Jun 2014 – Jan 2018 | Bengaluru
Resolved 150+ client-reported issues in PowerPlans, improving reliability and clinical workflow efficiency.
Maintained and enhanced the application to align with clinical protocols and patient safety standards.
Optimized codebase for better performance and usability, reducing downtime
Supported critical modules (multi-phase plans, IV sets, care sets), ensuring seamless clinician operations.
